modules.name: arm-cmsis-nn
modules.summary: Thin NSX wrapper around Arm's upstream CMSIS-NN implementation. It exposes the standard cmsis-nn library as nsx::arm_cmsis_nn for TFLM consumers.

modules.name: helia-dsp
modules.summary: NSX-packaged helia-dsp fork of CMSIS-DSP, preserving upstream Source/ CMake as the single source of truth.

modules.name: helia-rt-source
modules.summary: Source-provider module for consumers that compile the helia-rt TFLM source tree with their own NSX runtime wrapper.
use_cases: reference or upstream CMSIS-NN TFLM builds

modules.name: nsx-ambiq-bsp
modules.summary: Curated BSP wrapper surface for board-support integration on AmbiqSuite targets (all SoCs).
use_cases: board-support integration for any AmbiqSuite target
stable BSP access without wiring raw SDK board files by hand

modules.name: nsx-ambiq-hal
modules.summary: Curated Ambiq HAL wrapper surface for AmbiqSuite targets (all SoCs).
use_cases: access supported Ambiq HAL services on any AmbiqSuite SoC
wrap raw SDK HAL content behind a stable NSX-facing surface
dependency for platform and BSP integration

modules.name: nsx-ambiq-usb
modules.summary: Unified AmbiqSuite USB substrate (TinyUSB) for Apollo4P and Apollo5 SoCs.
use_cases: provide the Ambiq TinyUSB device-controller port for supported targets
expose SDK-vendored TinyUSB sources to higher-level USB modules
support bare-metal or framework-selected USB service loops

modules.name: nsx-ambiqsuite
modules.summary: Unified AmbiqSuite SDK provider covering all staged Apollo NSX targets.
use_cases: choose the AmbiqSuite SDK baseline for any Apollo-generation app
provide upstream SDK content for platform stacks
foundation for the Ambiq HAL and BSP layers

modules.name: nsx-audio
modules.summary: PDM audio capture helper for AmbiqSuite-backed NSX targets with staged PDM support.
use_cases: initialize board-supported PDM capture with caller-owned buffers
receive DMA-backed PCM sample callbacks from a PDM microphone
provide a stable NSX audio API across AmbiqSuite releases

modules.name: nsx-ble
modules.summary: Optional app-facing Bluetooth LE convenience API. Ports the legacy neuralSPOT ns-ble wrapper onto NSX, providing simple "define a service + read/write/notify characteristics with callbacks" bring-up on top of the Cordio host stack (nsx-cordio).
use_cases: stand up a single BLE GATT service with read/write/notify characteristics
port existing neuralSPOT ns-ble applications to NSX with minimal source changes
drive the Cordio stack from a FreeRTOS dispatcher task

modules.name: nsx-cmsis-core
modules.summary: Standalone CMSIS-Core(M) header package (ARM CMSIS_6 v6.2.0), decoupled from AmbiqSuite SDK vendoring.
use_cases: core peripheral access (NVIC, SCB, SysTick, MPU, PMU, cache)
compiler intrinsics dispatch (gcc / armclang / iccarm / clang)

modules.name: nsx-cmsis-nn
modules.summary: Ambiq-optimized CMSIS-NN neural network kernels. Fork of ARM CMSIS-NN with MVE and DSP optimizations for Apollo SoCs.
use_cases: quantized neural network inference on Cortex-M

modules.name: nsx-cmsis-startup
modules.summary: CMSIS and startup integration for vector tables, startup code, and early boot wiring.

modules.name: nsx-cordio
modules.summary: Optional Cordio/WSF Bluetooth LE host stack. Vendors the AmbiqSuite third_party Cordio stack (ble-host + ble-profiles + WSF) pinned to the provider SDK drop and builds it from source for the active SoC's BLE transport. Low-level stack only; the app-facing convenience API lives in nsx-ble.
use_cases: provide the Cordio BLE host stack (HCI/DM/L2CAP/ATT/SMP/GATT) to higher-level BLE modules
build the WSF FreeRTOS port for the active SoC
supply the SoC-specific BLE HCI transport driver (Cooper on Apollo4P, integrated BLE on Apollo3/Apollo3P, EM9305 on Apollo510B)

modules.name: nsx-core
modules.summary: Core runtime initialization, universal helpers, and byte ring-buffer support.
use_cases: printf, low-power debug output, delay, and interrupt helpers

modules.name: nsx-ethos-u-driver
modules.summary: NSX integration of Arm's Ethos-U core driver. Wraps the upstream ethos-u-core-driver (vendored as plain files) with NSX build glue, CMSIS-based cache coherency hooks, a board-supplied IRQ shim, and inference begin/end probes. Runtime-agnostic — consumed by HeliaAOT, HeliaRT, TFLM applications, and bespoke C runtimes alike.
use_cases: run Vela-compiled command streams on Ethos-U NPUs
NPU IRQ wiring and cache-coherent invocation on Armv8.1-M hosts
host-side begin/end probes for profiling (e.g. helia-profiler)

modules.name: nsx-freertos
modules.summary: Optional FreeRTOS kernel middleware. Vendors a pinned upstream FreeRTOS-Kernel and builds the SoC-selected CMSIS port. Kernel/heap policy and FreeRTOSConfig.h are owned by the application.
use_cases: run application tasks under a preemptive FreeRTOS scheduler
provide kernel objects (tasks, queues, semaphores, timers) to higher-level modules
opt-in RTOS scheduling without baking kernel or heap policy into the core SDK

modules.name: nsx-helia-rt
modules.summary: Ambiq-optimized TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers (TFLM) runtime. Built from source against the nsx-cmsis-nn (ns-cmsis-nn) kernel module.
use_cases: tflite model deployment on Ambiq SoCs
keyword spotting and anomaly detection models

modules.name: nsx-i2c
modules.summary: I2C bus API contract and register-access helpers for AmbiqSuite-backed NSX targets.
use_cases: shared register read/write helpers for I2C devices
base dependency for optional I2C device-driver modules

modules.name: nsx-nanopb
modules.summary: Vendored nanopb v0.4.9.1 — a small, zero-dynamic-memory Protocol Buffers implementation in ANSI C. Provides pb_encode / pb_decode for structured message serialisation over any transport (USB, UART, SPI, etc.). Pre-generated .pb.c/.pb.h files produced from .proto schemas are compiled into the application target; this module supplies only the runtime library.

modules.name: nsx-npu
modules.summary: Atomiq110 glue for the Arm Ethos-U85 NPU: power-domain sequencing, IRQ wiring, and performance-mode selection on top of the pristine upstream driver (nsx-ethos-u-driver) so TFLM runtimes can dispatch Vela-compiled command streams to the NPU.
use_cases: NPU power and performance mode control

modules.name: nsx-perf
modules.summary: Generic performance measurement helpers for timing and lightweight profiling.

modules.name: nsx-physiokit
modules.summary: Physiologic signal-processing primitives for ECG, PPG, respiration, IMU, and HRV workflows.

modules.name: nsx-pmu-armv8m
modules.summary: Armv8-M PMU helpers for hardware counter configuration, capture, and transport.

modules.name: nsx-power
modules.summary: AmbiqSuite power-management helpers for sleep policy, shutdown control, and low-power workflows across supported Apollo3, Apollo4, and Apollo5 targets.

modules.name: nsx-sensors
modules.summary: Reusable external sensor and accessory drivers built on NSX transport modules.

modules.name: nsx-soc-hal
modules.summary: Shared SoC-level HAL integration layer for NSX targets.
use_cases: base dependency for most NSX runtime modules

modules.name: nsx-spi
modules.summary: SPI wrapper helpers for talking to SPI-attached devices and peripherals.

modules.name: nsx-tflite-micro
modules.summary: Thin NSX wrapper for the helia-rt TensorFlow Lite Micro runtime using reference kernels or standard Arm CMSIS-NN kernels.

modules.name: nsx-tileio-ble
modules.summary: Tileio BLE transport wrapper on top of nsx-ble.
use_cases: stream Tileio slot data over BLE notifications
receive Tileio UIO state updates over BLE

modules.name: nsx-tileio-usb
modules.summary: Tileio USB transport wrapper on top of nsx-usb.
use_cases: stream Tileio slot data over USB vendor transport
receive Tileio slot and UIO updates from a host

modules.name: nsx-uart
modules.summary: UART wrapper helpers for serial communication, console I/O, and simple host-device links.

modules.name: nsx-usb
modules.summary: USB CDC serial driver for Ambiq SoCs using the SDK-hosted TinyUSB substrate.
use_cases: Host-device serial link over USB CDC
Streaming sensor or audio data to a PC

unchecked_projects.helia-dsp: a private repository, so a run without credentials cannot read its manifests
